title: Local flat orthonormal coframings with prescribed real-analytic closed R3-valued derived two-forms having no common contraction kernel
author: Robert L. Bryant; Jeanne N. Clelland
work: Flat Metrics with a Prescribed Derived Coframing
source_version: SIGMA 16 (2020), article 004, published version of record; official EMIS Brno PDF/native bytes exactly match historical publisher pins; acquired 2026-10-03
difficulty_reason: The proof converts a flat-metric coframing system to an exterior differential system with independence conditions. It parametrizes admissible integral elements, computes polar spaces and an exceptional-matrix tableau classification, then establishes a regular integral flag even in the rank-two case. The Cartan-Kahler application rests on these new symbol and involutivity calculations, which also determine the three functions of two variables in the solution count.
